CONTENT-19.note: user-storage searchUsers escapes % _ \ (ESCAPE '\'), strips control chars, caps at 50 chars; route ignores non-string q (?q[]=, ?q[$ne]=).

AUTH-2.note: getUserByUsername/getUserByEmail compare lower() (exact match preferred if old case variants exist; SQLite COLLATE NOCASE), so register/login/PATCH /api/profile in auth.ts reject case variants without changes there. Defense-in-depth unique indexes on lower(username)/lower(email): server/migrations/user_case_uniqueness.ts ensureCaseInsensitiveUserUniqueness() - must be called at startup (core: server/index.ts after ensurePostgresColumns). It skips (and logs) a column while duplicates exist: the ovroutes test DB has 6 username and 6 email case-duplicates (test accounts, e.g. 315:Casemvc18e6lc/316:casemvc18e6lc); nothing is deleted or renamed. Email is not lower-cased on write (display kept).

AUTH-6.note: GET /api/users/:username uses toPublicUser (toSelfUser for the owner), search uses toPublicUser, mutualFollowers mapped too (they leaked full rows incl. hash). The /api/user part (auth.ts:463, shadow ban visible to the user) belongs to core: return toSelfUser(req.user) there.

AUTH-9.note: Private profile: /:username/posts|comments|liked answer 403 {code PRIVATE_PROFILE} to anonymous visitors (UI text 'Only members can see your content' = logged-in members); owner and logged-in users see them; stats.posts is 0 for anonymous viewers of a private profile.

UI-10.note: Shared insertCommunitySchema: name trim min 3 max 100, must contain a letter/digit (any script); the client's zodResolver now blocks the empty form (message is zod English; client agent may add translated messages). Server never creates an empty slug.

INPUT-1.note: getNotifications selects only actor id, username, displayName, avatarUrl, profilePictureUrl.

INPUT-3.note: PATCH /api/notifications/preferences validated by zod: only the 12 flag keys (boolean or 0/1); storage writes only those keys, never id/userId/updatedAt.

INPUT-4.note: booleans map to 0/1; other types -> 400 VALIDATION_ERROR.

SOCIAL-5.note: markNotificationAsReadForUser / archiveNotificationForUser scope the UPDATE to user_id; 404 'Notification not found' when nothing matched.

SOCIAL-7.note: approve requires a pending request (updateJoinRequestStatus now returns whether a pending row changed; 404 NO_PENDING_REQUEST otherwise); decline likewise. addCommunityMember uses ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING; migrations/0003_community_members_unique.sql removes duplicate memberships (keeps highest role, then oldest; 16 duplicate pairs in ovroutes) and adds unique index (community_id,user_id).

SOCIAL-8.note: invite, moderators and approve answer 409 USER_BANNED_FROM_COMMUNITY for a banned target.

SOCIAL-9.note: no 'details' in error bodies; ids validated by validateIdParams (404).

SOCIAL-10.note: GET /:id/members: 404 for unknown community, 403 (code PRIVATE_COMMUNITY) via canViewCommunity for private ones.

SOCIAL-11.note: community reports drop ipAddress and reporterId unless the viewer is global admin/owner.

SOCIAL-17.note: messageSchema: receiverId int 1..2^31-1, content trim min 1 max 5000, no NUL.

SOCIAL-18.note: GET /api/messages/:userId marks received messages of that conversation read (markConversationAsRead).

SOCIAL-19.note: getConversation returns the newest 100 (oldest first); ?before=<messageId> pages back.

SOCIAL-20.note: POST /api/messages uses notificationService.notify({actorId: sender, type new_message, preview, actionUrl /chat/<sender>}).

SOCIAL-21.note: updateNotificationPreferences creates the row first; returns the saved row.

SOCIAL-22.note: validateIdParams on users (userId), messages (userId), notifications (id), communities (id,userId,reportId); body ids via parseId; notifications paging via parsePagination; reason strips control chars.

SOCIAL-23.note: insertCommunitySchema is an explicit z.object (id/createdAt dropped), name max 100, description max 1000, imageUrl only '' / http(s) URL / /uploads/<file>, allowedCategories enum list (news, entertainment, discussion, general).

SOCIAL-24.note: names need a letter/digit (400 otherwise); names with letters but no ASCII letters/digits (e.g. Greek) get a random slug c-<hex>.

SOCIAL-25.note: follow only notifies when the target has no unarchived new_follower notification from the same actor.

SOCIAL-26.note: all error answers in users/communities/notifications/messages are JSON {error, code?}.

AUTHZ-10.note: community join-request routes fixed (no details, id validation). The DELETE /api/admin/users/:id part is in admin.ts (admin agent).

ATK-INJECT-1.note: notification query params only used when plain strings; type list trimmed/limited.

ATK-INJECT-4.note: messages/communities routers use validateIdParams; usernames with control chars or >100 chars answer 404 (router.param + storage guard). tickets/admin-performance parts belong to other agents.
